name: Covalent
tagline: Unified multichain blockchain data API for wallets, tokens, NFTs, and on-chain analytics
description: Covalent (covalenthq.com) provides a unified REST API that indexes blockchain data across many networks so developers can query balances, transactions, token transfers, NFTs, and historical prices without running their own nodes. Typical usage is authenticated API-key requests against a versioned HTTPS base URL for wallet portfolio, activity, and token metadata endpoints.

auth.details: API key via Authorization Bearer header or query parameter (self-serve signup on Covalent platform)

use_cases: get token balances for a wallet address on a chain
list recent transactions for an address
fetch NFT holdings for a wallet
query token transfer activity across chains
